snippet.title: Leaf Blower Co -- Launch Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Leaf Blower Co. launches on Steam on November 17! 🍂
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3571710/Leaf_Blower_Co

It’s time to clear away the clutter and bring a little peace and tranquillity back to the world. From the school playground to the tennis court, and even a last-minute cleanup for the Mayor, grab your trusty blower, earn cash, and make your leaf-blowing business truly your own.

The full game includes over twenty unique levels and locations, upgradable tools, unlockable skills, and plenty of cosmetics to keep your business looking sharp!

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/xZt4fPVafZ
